limitations: Uses banked force tables conditionally while full force rerun is active.
No contamination, self-consistent orbit, real Galactic-direction or mass-ratio force correction.
Fisher forecast only; no frequentist coverage or detection calibration.
κ derivative is local at κ_cal=1; window [.95,1.05] not imposed as a stochastic prior.
Sample objects have no shared-star graph; whole-pair resampling suffices only for this independent mock.
Limited model population and bootstrap draws cause Monte Carlo forecast variability.
